sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def snap(fr):
    seg=fr.segmentation
    out={}
    for nd in seg['nodes']:
        if nd['color'] in ('N','O','Y') and nd['pixels']>=8:
            out.setdefault(nd['color'],[]).append(nd['boundary'][0])
    return out
print("before:", snap(current_frame))
# click orange token center
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':34,'col':32}])
print("after click orange:", snap(current_frame))
print("res:", {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ['board_changed','level_completed','done','game_over']})
# check for any new ring/selection node (dark gray G or new small node)
seg=current_frame.segmentation
for nd in seg['nodes']:
    if nd['color']=='G' or (nd['color']=='c' and nd['pixels']<40):
        print("sel?", nd['color'], nd['pixels'], nd['boundary'])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
